mapper.sql: ur.id, ur.user_id, ur.rule_id, ur.start_date, ur.end_date, ur.enabled, ur.create_by, ur.update_by, ur.create_time, ur.update_time
mapper.select: select , u.username, r.rule_name, r.rule_type, r.cycle_days from sch_user_rule ur left join sys_user u on ur.user_id = u.user_id left join sch_shift_rule r on ur.rule_id = r.rule_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and ur.enabled = 1 and r.enabled = 1 order by ur.start_date desc limit 1
mapper.insert:
insert into sch_user_rule (user_id, rule_id, start_date, end_date, enabled, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values
(#{item.userId}, #{item.ruleId}, #{item.startDate}, #{item.endDate}, #{item.enabled}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateBy}, #{item.updateTime})
